answer: Give each identity rotating sole custody of a shared help queue for one full epoch: only the custodian can answer, sign and close tickets, and the next custodian audits the handover. The queue sits at a harbor desk where a falcon tally of open tickets is posted each morning and recounted before acceptance. A mirror log kept by a stranger must match exactly, and any lotus-stamped urgent ticket left unanswered is a public miss. One operator with a thousand clones must still staff a thousand custody days with real, unpredictable work; an unattended shift is a gap tied to one name.
